text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle... Series...
In order to "dash across" this galaxy—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe needs—
'Energy.' That is why..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"The star of "FOTX".
Gathering its radiance to unleash the power of the 7th stage—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the small hill in the night.
There... my trainee, Neo Universe, was doing something.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... "accumulation."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe cannot sustain herself
as "STDA"…… Type Ia…… 1・7・5……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words are cryptic, and grasping their meaning is no easy task. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's not that she's talking nonsense. Neo Universe's intellect is just so high that my understanding simply can't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems that barrier of intellect brought along quite a bit of sorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, that was before we met...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry.
I can't be your trainer, but
I'll be praying for your success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Another Trainer refused to sign a contract with her,
citing that they couldn't understand each other.
A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I met her and asked,
'Would you let me help you?'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I met her and asked,
'Won't you let me help you?'...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Po... wer...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Sfira.
Very... Sfira, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She accepted me.
For some reason, we hit it off right from the moment we met, and we got along quite well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, our contract was forged.
I want to do whatever it takes to make Neo Universe's dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Neo Universe wants to...
"connect" through the race.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Rendezvous." If we run... we can understand each other.
Lining up side by side, our consciousness will... "connect."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's run a whole lot.
Yeah, let's run a whole lot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe's wish is to 'connect with other Umamusume'
through races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running is the universal language of all Umamusume.
If you make a name for yourself in races,
it should resolve any isolation as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Connect," and then... "ANOI."
—One more.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe has something
she wants to 'accomplish.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...? ...The "noise"... is intense.
Neo Universe is... not yet...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Inside the "jamming"...
"PABL"... "ELNKL"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, I couldn't tell what she was feeling.
However, to Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have other hidden motives as well.
Perhaps they will come to light
through her future racing career.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, operations began. Neo Universe
has yet to debut, but her running—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew...
choice_data_list: Incredible... They're on a whole different level.
Amazing... They're on a completely different level, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes... "Thank you"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her raw talent clearly stood out from the rest.
Truly on another dimension.
A stride like a visitor from outer space...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Entering the same class as her was—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Whoa... You're so fast, Uni-san!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno... Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A 'thank you' to you as well.
Conceptually, you are Neo Universe's—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —"Best friends forever."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Bestie!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
I'm so happy to hear you say that, Uni.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Zenno Rob Roy.
A quiet member of the library committee who
secretly longs to be a hero herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they got to know each other
because Neo Universe visits the library often.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to be acknowledged, but...
I'm still way behind Uni-san.
In my race preparations...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To think even the very first page is in jeopardy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Still, I'll do my best to make my debut around the same time!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The near... future...?
Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uni-san? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy, you are—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
No. ...Negative.
This is—the "remnants" of a star.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My days with Neo Universe are finally about to begin.
She's a horse girl unlike any other, after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no telling what kind of future
or events lie in wait for us.
